bonus_hunt.tagline: Utah's Hogle Zoo bonus · second-loop secrets

challenges.text: Watch one animal do something for 15 full seconds (eat, climb, pace, rest)
Match two patterns in different places (stripes, spots, shells)
Find something tiny next to something huge
Find a cool detail most visitors walk past
Stand still 20 seconds — loudest sound that isn’t people?
Find water used by animals (pool, moat, splash, drink)
Copy an animal move once (stomp, stretch, tip-toe, roar soft)

bonus_hunt.easter_egg: ★ Easter egg: find a park map or zone sign — name one animal that lives that way
